Vacancy under ICMR HBCR PROJECT
Friday, 22 August 2025
1788 Hits
Department of Pathology
ICMR HBCR PROJECT
Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram
The candidate for the following position will be hired purely on contract basis for an ICMR project being implemented by the Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram with financial support & technical leads from the National Centre for Disease Informatics and Research (NCDIR), Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Bengaluru.
The candidate will be hired purely on contract basis and will not be considered as employee of Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram or the ICMR. The project may be terminated at any time in between without any prior intimation.
Project: HOSPITAL BASED CANCER REGISTRY
Duration: One and half years. However, the initial contract will be for six months from the date of joining.
Data Entry Operator cum Field Assistant- Number of positions: 01
1   Qualifications  :  Bachelor’s  degree in science/ Computer science or Bachelor’s  degree in  Arts AND certificate course in Data Entry Operator is essential.
2   Skills  :         1 -  A speed test of not less than 40-50 words /min. Proficiency  with  computer software (especially for Microsoft office)
2 -  Work organisation
3 -  Time management skills
4 -  Communication skills
5 -  Working knowledge of Marathi and English is desirable
3   Experience :     Working on computer with 3 years of relevant experience.
The criteria regarding years of experience may be relaxed for exceptional candidates with relevant education, subject to the discretion of the selection panel.
Remuneration
– Rs. 1,27,200 for six months in monthly instalments
80% for input and updating data into HBCR software
20%  for field work
Job description
:
-           Accurately input, update and maintain data in HBCR software.
-           Ensuring the quality, consistency and accuracy of data input.
-           Verifying and cross- checking the data accuracy to ensure no errors.
-           Perform regular data backup and quality check to ensure security and prevent loss.
-           Assisting in retrieving and organising data for reports, audits, trainings, workshops and meetings.
-           Collaborating with team members to resolve data related issues and improve process.
-           Maintaining data confidentially and adhering to data protection policies.
-           Abstraction of medical records of OPD and IPD patients.
-           Filling the HBCR core form.
-           Follow up of patients via phone calls, home visits, whenever need be.
-           Attend regular staff trainings and other meetings as requested.
The interested candidates shall apply by 25/08/2025 through the following Google form link by filling the prescribed application form and attaching their latest CV and statement of intent.
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeB_zxTlHUlxhslTJZNl7sh5rdq-3F4LdvjTem_loSaOJPXDg/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid
=111857287061902092588
Only qualified candidates will be called for written/ practical examination and/or interview at Pathology Department, Sevagram and will need to produce their original certificates of qualification and experience.  No TA/DA will be paid for this purpose.
Dr. Anshu
Principal Investigator- HBCR
Director Professor
Department of Pathology, MGIMS, Sevagram
Wardha – 442102
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
